comment: DGX Spark (GB10) lock for the C1+D8+D9+D10 CUDA build (SPARK_MILESTONES.md S13): the D8/D9 combined patch plus D10 (GPU TB encoder kept its own LDPC filler count when the CPU segmenter supplied F=0, so zero-filler multi-CB TBs, e.g. 9474 bytes = 9 BG1 CBs at Z=384, were encoded with the wrong K). D10 alone is integrations/ocudu/patches/s-d10-tb-encoder-zero-filler.patch on top of s-c1-d8-d9.patch; this lock carries the combined patch. Separate checkout src/ocudu-cuda-d10 and build. cpu_baseline as in cuda-workspace.spark.lock.json.

cpu_baseline.comment: Non-CUDA OCUDU gNB for the S3/S5 CPU baseline (live-direct-zmq.sh cpu). Same commit as the workstation native lock; built by s3-build-stack.sh with MCPU=neoverse-v2, MARCH=armv9-a.
